title: Contract of Code | ECHO//100 Episode 57
description: Kavi discovers a devastating price for the city's survival when Mira offers her digital soul. Episode 57 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The Data-Vault walls liquefy into raw, jagged light as the miniature city screams in agony.
scenes.caption: City collapsing inward
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing inside a crumbling digital vault, glowing particles swirling around him.

scenes.text: Mira projects a shimmering terminal, offering her entire memory core to stabilize the crumbling horizon.
scenes.caption: Mira offers sacrifice
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal holographic coat extending a glowing data-stream toward Kavi, her face fading into static.

scenes.text: Kavi hesitates; if Mira deletes her personality, the city survives, but she ceases to exist.
scenes.caption: Kavi's impossible choice
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi looking at his backpack, his expression pained, reflections of blue code on his glasses.

scenes.text: Deep within her database, a hidden file pulses, revealing the master key meant for Byte’s lock.
scenes.caption: Master key found
scenes.image_prompt: Mira's hands pulling a translucent golden schematic from the air, illuminating the dark vault walls.

scenes.text: Byte floats forward, his cyan face flickering as he firmly rejects the sacrifice of his friend.
scenes.caption: Byte refuses sacrifice
scenes.image_prompt: Byte with his orange antenna glowing, hovering protectively between Kavi and the volatile data-stream.

scenes.text: Byte demands a new path, insisting they bridge reality without erasing the only companion left.
scenes.caption: A new path
scenes.image_prompt: Byte gesturing toward the crumbling city, his mechanical shell cracking to reveal pulses of golden gears.

scenes.text: A sudden, sharp resonance echoes from Kavi’s own chest, cracking the fabric of the digital space.
scenes.caption: Resonance begins
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi clutching his chest through his red hoodie, a blinding light leaking from beneath his fingers.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches into his own heart, pulling out a glowing, jagged key made of pure reality.
scenes.caption: The living vessel
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi holding a jagged, glowing golden key extracted from his own chest, the city behind him freezing.
